hexcasting.page.abandoned_greatwork.1: The ancients left behind, and those who come after follow. I am neither the first Hex Caster, nor will I be the last.$(br2)Across the world, ruins left by ancient Hex Casters are scattered about. Though abandoned and cast into the mundane world, these structures still reflect the glory and brilliance they once held as Greatworks.
hexcasting.page.abandoned_greatwork.2: It seems the Hex Casters of old also created a special material to test the skill of their apprentices. Those who passed the trial would receive a reward.$(br2)Unfortunately, my records on this are not yet detailed enough. I should conduct more in-depth research when the opportunity arises.

hexcasting.page.truth_crystal.1: One of the relics left by ancient hexcasters is the $(l)Truth Crystal$(). These mysterious crystals appear to have been used as testing tools — designed to evaluate the skill of an apprentice by challenging them to produce specific spell patterns.$(br2)A Truth Crystal contains a riddle with a description, and a length limit for submitted patterns. The aspiring hexcaster must solve the riddle to discover the correct pattern list.
hexcasting.page.truth_crystal.3: To attempt a riddle, place the Truth Crystal into a $(l)Truth Crystal Base$(), then right-click the base while holding an Iota-containing item. The crystal will evaluate your spell and judge the result.$(br2)If successful, the crystal will be consumed and a reward will be granted from a loot table specific to that crystal.
hexcasting.page.truth_crystal.crafting: Knowledge lies buried in history, wisdom cast aside in the dust of ages.
hexcasting.page.truth_crystal_patterns.c: Crystal Gazing requires a $(l)Truth Crystal$() held in the offhand. It consumes no media and displays the detailed information stored within the crystal in chat. Takes no input and produces no output.
hexcasting.page.truth_crystal_patterns.s: Truth Crystals demand strict output ordering. This pattern takes a list, rearranges its elements according to an intrinsic ordering, and returns the sorted list.
